shots.headline: A steady beat to practise with
shots.sub: Tempo, time signature, sound and accents, in a tab of its own in Lumi.

callout.title: Metronome
callout.label: Classic
callout.body: A wind-up pendulum. Drag its weight to change the tempo.

shots.headline: See the whole bar go round
shots.sub: Orbit draws the bar as a ring, with a hand sweeping round it.

callout.title: Metronome
callout.label: Steady
callout.body: Kept on the Mac's audio clock, however busy the Mac is.

shots.headline: Accent any beat, or leave one out
shots.sub: Beat Pads gives every beat a pad of its own.

callout.title: Metronome
callout.label: Click a pad to change it
callout.body: Accent, normal or silent. The clicks inside each beat light up as dots.

shots.headline: Come back to it in one click
shots.sub: Keep what you set as a preset. The one you are on lights up.

callout.title: Metronome
callout.label: Right-click a preset
callout.body: Rename it, replace it with what is set now, or delete it. A delete can be undone.
